messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: svc=redwood-runtime-us-west · error-rate spike to 9.8% · 504 timeouts and client cancels observed · probable trigger: kv-cache churn coinciding with quant-kernel v2.0.0-canary rollout (rolled at 16:12 UTC). Link: https://redwood.example.com/alerts/2320011111

harper: oncall here — seeing large tail latencies and timeouts across generation routes. dashboard shows per-pod mem pressure and sudden eviction bursts. I'm going to pause the canary and take ownership.

diego: investigating logs now. quick glance: eviction_count per-second jumped from ~30/s -> 2.2k/s at 16:14:08 UTC. lots of `kvcache: evict reason=oom_candidate` traces. suspect the new quant kernel increases KV entry size or affects memory accounting. Also seeing increased batch assembly time which may amplify KV retention.

mei: metrics snapshot:
- kv_cache_hit_rate: 97.3% -> 58.7%
- kvcache_evictions_total: +1.2M in 13m
- avg_request_latency: 120ms -> 780ms (p95 -> p99 stretched)
- canary-pod mem RSS increased ~28% post-rollout
logs: `quant-kernel: allocate kvcache_buf size=65536` repeated in stack traces.

harper: mitigation plan (live):
1) pause canary rollout -> `redwoodctl rollout pause --name quant-kernel --env prod --selector canary`
2) pin affected production model to prior kernel: `redwoodctl model pin --model gen-prod-13b --kernel v1.9.7 --region us-west`
3) set batching.window_ms=5 and batching.max_batch_size=4 for critical routes to reduce simultaneous KV pressure: `redwoodctl config set --route /v1/generate --key batching.window_ms --value 5`
4) enable fail-fast circuit breaker for retries: `redwoodctl routing circuit-breaker set --route /v1/generate --error-rate-threshold 0.05`
Executing 1 & 2 now.

ops-bot: Scale: added 3 GPU nodes to pool redwood-runtime-us-west (event id: scale-99c2).

harper: (3m) canary pause ACKed, pin applied to 6 pods. watching recovery.

diego: (4m) after pin KV hit rate recovering to ~82%. evictions trending down but still above baseline. collecting heap profiles & kernel allocation traces. starting flamegraphs capture and per-pod heap dumps.

sam: customer-impact update: BlueBank reported user-visible errors and delayed responses from 16:13–16:20 UTC (~7m). CloudCart saw partial failures for checkout routing (~4% of transactions). I've opened CS-1892 and notified account reps. Marking incident P1 due to financial product impact. :rotating_light:

pm-jo: please make sure we schedule a postmortem within 36 hours and include runtime, infra, SRE, and support. Proposed follow-up: 2026-03-17 11:00 PT. Expect deliverables: timeline, root cause hypothesis, reproducer attempt, and remediation plan.

diego: creating tickets now:
- INF-4801 (infra): cluster scaling & rollout gating
- RT-3502 (runtime): kv-cache memory accounting + kernel regression
Assigning owners and adding logs/flamegraphs to tickets.

mei: proposed long-term remediations (RT-3502):
- tighten rollout gating to check eviction_rate and mem-RSS delta before canary promotion
- add synthetic load tests that exercise KV cache with quantized kernels (staging)
- add per-model cache reserve: `cache.kv.reserve_bytes` default bump to 768MB for quantized models
- improved telemetry: instrument per-kernel kvcache entry sizes

harper: action items (short):
- harper -> incident timeline + attach pod heapdumps to PM doc (WIP)
- diego -> RT-3502 ticket + alloc traces & reproducer attempt (assigned)
- mei -> add per-model eviction alerts and staging tests (assigned)
- sam -> customer comms + update CS tickets (assigned)
- pm-jo -> schedule postmortem + send calendar invite (assigned)

pm-jo: postmortem scheduled: 2026-03-17 11:00 PT · calendar invite sent. Drive doc: https://drive.redwood.example.com/pm/kvcache-quant-2320011111. Please add any evidence and pre-read notes.

ops-bot: Tickets created: INF-4801, RT-3502. Postmortem doc link added to incident thread.

diego: handing off oncall to alex in 25m. Notes for next oncall: monitor kvcache.eviction_rate, per-pod RSS, and guard runway before any quant kernel rollout. If eviction_rate > 500/s persist > 5m, rollback immediately.

harper: thanks everyone. I'll keep monitoring for 1 hour then close urgent paging. Keep this thread open for postmortem edits. :white_check_mark:
